Author: Kotanna
Name: Chocobo Barding
Punchline: Put barding on your chocobo with one command.
Description: Use /cbarding "Sophic" to equip a full barding set, or /cbarding "Suzaku" "Windswept" "Ice" for a different piece per slot, e.g. from a job macro. Pick a barding per job and put it on with /cbarding job; /cbarding greens uses Gysahl Greens to summon your chocobo. Only barding you own can be equipped. /cbarding on its own opens a window that builds the macro line for you.
